show.description: A wealthy heir with ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis) meets a tribal healer who miraculously cures him using the mystical Rakta Kamal flower. Their bond turns into love amid family conflict, media scandals, and supernatural trials testing faith and loyalty. In the end, love triumphs, healing bridges two worlds and uniting their families forever. Watch now.
